note: Cloudflare Web Analytics on the pages (ADR-0096). Empty token = no script on the pages and the privacy words say there is no page analytics. With the site token of Cloudflare Web Analytics (32 hex characters; it is public, it is in the page) the build adds exactly one script, the one of static.cloudflareinsights.com, and the privacy words say what it counts. Both change together or the build fails. Turn off the automatic injection in the Cloudflare dashboard first, or the script comes twice.
